findings.reason: §3's artifact consumes both receipts and the pin asserts against both, so naming one shared receipt/timing/schema owner (currently absent from `benchmarks/`) is the difference between one interface and two that drift; the plan already carries a stated divergence between the two gates' qualification rules.
findings.text: `_strict` is byte-identical to `benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:236` and both modules re-declare `_timed_stage`; each builds a `{"schema": ..., "data": ...}` receipt, one hand-validating via `receipt["schema"]["required"]` and the other via `jsonschema.Draft202012Validator` — two receipt owners for the two halves of one certificate

findings.reason: the two pin tests already disagree on this one receipt (`test_pinned_certificate_retains_its_census_and_render_integrity` asserts `unqualified_rows: 15`, `test_pinned_certificate_refuses_unqualified_production_rows` asserts none), which is exactly the failure a third reader of one receipt produces; extending the existing certificate tests or the harness's own verdict surface would remove the fork.
findings.text: the §3 pin re-derives per-row qualification (`_unqualified_rows` over `case["rows"]`) that the receipt already exposes as `verdict` (`qualified_rows`/`unqualified_rows`) and validates itself, and it re-reads the same receipt `tests/test_certificate_baseline_revision.py` and `tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py` already read; the plan gives no reason the pin could not extend those

findings.reason: naming `scripts/accuracy_cost_ladder` (or the receipt's own timing fields) as the cost owner turns §3's open "record the cost" into "extend the existing cost record", which is also what the `millisecond-converged-solve` consumer reads.
findings.text: §3's done-when "records what an accuracy re-certification costs (wall time and lanes) so it can be repeated per release" restates the job `scripts/accuracy_cost_ladder/measure.py` already does (profiling closed-form oracle build and fixed-point solve cost, banked in `scripts/accuracy_cost_ladder/results.json`), and the certificate receipt already stamps per-row wall and `stage_timings`

findings.reason: the evidence-page form is mandated by the plan system and the test readers serve CI while the pages serve a human, so consolidation would fight the plan-artifact contract; the reuse that matters here is the receipt owner (see the duplicate_owner findings), not a merged interface.
findings.text: §3 realises the certificate as a receipt plus a render-data schema plus an artifact page plus two per-machine EFIT-match pages plus three test modules, each a thin reader of the same receipt, so no single interface hides the receipt shape

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the certificate's behaviour is spread across one receipt, a render-data schema, an evidence page, two per-machine EFIT-match pages and three test modules, each a small reader of the same receipt, rather than one module exposing the certificate behind a small interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan authored two gate harnesses (`benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py`, `benchmarks/efit_reproduction_gate.py`) that each fork the same receipt scaffolding (`_timed_stage`, `_strict`, `_sha256`) and their own receipt schema/validation; §3 assembles both into one certificate while the two owners are left to drift.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan ran a reuse scout and cites it (`docs/research/forward-accuracy-reuse-map.html`, 45-row inventory across nova/ambix/reckon) and names the mechanisms it extends (`benchmarks/analytic_operator_ladder.py` regional norms and order fit as the aggregation skeleton, `RotatingEquilibrium`, `split_fit_jump_field.py`, the `tests/test_solovev_recovery_gates.py` reduced-oracle path) rather than proposing a parallel subsystem.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the §3 pin (`tests/test_certificate_pin.py`) adds a further lane over the certificate receipt that the harness already self-validates and that `tests/test_certificate_baseline_revision.py` already reads, with no statement of why those cannot be extended.
